breve: A server interface for OS native menus.
descricao:
NativeMenu handles low-level access to the OS native global menu bar and popup menus.
Note: This is low-level API, consider using MenuBar with 'MenuBar.prefer_global_menu' set to true, and PopupMenu with 'PopupMenu.prefer_native_menu' set to true.
To create a menu, use 'create_menu', add menu items using add_*_item methods. To remove a menu, use 'free_menu'.

```gdscript
var menu

func _menu_callback(item_id):
	if item_id == "ITEM_CUT":
		cut()
	elif item_id == "ITEM_COPY":
		copy()
	elif item_id == "ITEM_PASTE":
		paste()

func _enter_tree():
	# Create new menu and add items:
	menu = NativeMenu.create_menu()
	NativeMenu.add_item(menu, "Cut", _menu_callback, Callable(), "ITEM_CUT")
	NativeMenu.add_item(menu, "Copy", _menu_callback, Callable(), "ITEM_COPY")
	NativeMenu.add_separator(menu)
	NativeMenu.add_item(menu, "Paste", _menu_callback, Callable(), "ITEM_PASTE")

func _on_button_pressed():
	# Show popup menu at mouse position:
	NativeMenu.popup(menu, DisplayServer.mouse_get_position())

func _exit_tree():
	# Remove menu when it's no longer needed:
	NativeMenu.free_menu(menu)
```

metodos.assinatura: add_check_item(rid: RID, label: String, callback: Callable = Callable(), key_callback: Callable = Callable(), tag: Variant = null, accelerator: Key = 0, index: int = -1) -> int
metodos.desc:
Adds a new checkable item with text 'label' to the global menu 'rid'.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as 'index' value.
An 'accelerator' can optionally be defined, which is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if it's not currently open. The 'accelerator' is generally a combination of 'KeyModifierMask's and 'Key's using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A).
Note: The 'callback' and 'key_callback' Callables need to accept exactly one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callables will be the value passed to 'tag'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
Note: On Windows, 'accelerator' and 'key_callback' are ignored.

metodos.assinatura: add_multistate_item(rid: RID, label: String, max_states: int, default_state: int, callback: Callable = Callable(), key_callback: Callable = Callable(), tag: Variant = null, accelerator: Key = 0, index: int = -1) -> int
metodos.desc:
Adds a new item with text 'label' to the global menu 'rid'.
Contrarily to normal binary items, multistate items can have more than two states, as defined by 'max_states'. Each press or activate of the item will increase the state by one. The default value is defined by 'default_state'.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as 'index' value.
An 'accelerator' can optionally be defined, which is a keyboard shortcut that can be pressed to trigger the menu button even if it's not currently open. The 'accelerator' is generally a combination of 'KeyModifierMask's and 'Key's using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A).
Note: By default, there's no indication of the current item state, it should be changed manually.
Note: The 'callback' and 'key_callback' Callables need to accept exactly one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callables will be the value passed to 'tag'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
Note: On Windows, 'accelerator' and 'key_callback' are ignored.

metodos.assinatura: add_separator(rid: RID, index: int = -1) -> int
metodos.desc:
Adds a separator between items to the global menu 'rid'. Separators also occupy an index.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as 'index' value.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: add_submenu_item(rid: RID, label: String, submenu_rid: RID, tag: Variant = null, index: int = -1) -> int
metodos.desc:
Adds an item that will act as a submenu of the global menu 'rid'. The 'submenu_rid' argument is the RID of the global menu that will be shown when the item is clicked.
Returns index of the inserted item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as 'index' value.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: clear(rid: RID) -> void
metodos.desc:
Removes all items from the global menu 'rid'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: create_menu() -> RID
metodos.desc:
Creates a new global menu object.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: find_item_index_with_submenu(rid: RID, submenu_rid: RID) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns the index of the item with the submenu specified by 'submenu_rid'. Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: find_item_index_with_tag(rid: RID, tag: Variant) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns the index of the item with the specified 'tag'. Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: find_item_index_with_text(rid: RID, text: String) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns the index of the item with the specified 'text'. Indices are automatically assigned to each item by the engine.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: free_menu(rid: RID) -> void
metodos.desc:
Frees a global menu object created by this NativeMenu.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_accelerator(rid: RID, idx: int) -> Key const
metodos.desc:
Returns the accelerator of the item at index 'idx'. Accelerators are special combinations of keys that activate the item, no matter which control is focused.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_callback(rid: RID, idx: int) -> Callable const
metodos.desc:
Returns the callback of the item at index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_count(rid: RID) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns number of items in the global menu 'rid'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_icon(rid: RID, idx: int) -> Texture2D const
metodos.desc:
Returns the icon of the item at index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_indentation_level(rid: RID, idx: int) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns the horizontal offset of the item at the given 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_key_callback(rid: RID, idx: int) -> Callable const
metodos.desc:
Returns the callback of the item accelerator at index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_max_states(rid: RID, idx: int) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns number of states of a multistate item. See 'add_multistate_item' for details.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_state(rid: RID, idx: int) -> int const
metodos.desc:
Returns the state of a multistate item. See 'add_multistate_item' for details.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_submenu(rid: RID, idx: int) -> RID const
metodos.desc:
Returns the submenu ID of the item at index 'idx'. See 'add_submenu_item' for more info on how to add a submenu.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_tag(rid: RID, idx: int) -> Variant const
metodos.desc:
Returns the metadata of the specified item, which might be of any type. You can set it with 'set_item_tag', which provides a simple way of assigning context data to items.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_text(rid: RID, idx: int) -> String const
metodos.desc:
Returns the text of the item at index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_item_tooltip(rid: RID, idx: int) -> String const
metodos.desc:
Returns the tooltip associated with the specified index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_minimum_width(rid: RID) -> float const
metodos.desc:
Returns global menu minimum width.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_popup_close_callback(rid: RID) -> Callable const
metodos.desc:
Returns global menu close callback.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_popup_open_callback(rid: RID) -> Callable const
metodos.desc:
Returns global menu open callback.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_size(rid: RID) -> Vector2 const
metodos.desc:
Returns global menu size.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: get_system_menu(menu_id: NativeMenu.SystemMenus) -> RID const
metodos.desc:
Returns RID of a special system menu.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_system_menu_name(menu_id: NativeMenu.SystemMenus) -> String const
metodos.desc:
Returns readable name of a special system menu.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: get_system_menu_text(menu_id: NativeMenu.SystemMenus) -> String const
metodos.desc:
Returns the text of the system menu item.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: has_feature(feature: NativeMenu.Feature) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the specified 'feature' is supported by the current NativeMenu, false otherwise.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: has_menu(rid: RID) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if 'rid' is valid global menu.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: has_system_menu(menu_id: NativeMenu.SystemMenus) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if a special system menu is supported.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: is_item_checkable(rid: RID, idx: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the item at index 'idx' is checkable in some way, i.e. if it has a checkbox or radio button.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: is_item_checked(rid: RID, idx: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the item at index 'idx' is checked.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: is_item_disabled(rid: RID, idx: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the item at index 'idx' is disabled. When it is disabled it can't be selected, or its action invoked.
See 'set_item_disabled' for more info on how to disable an item.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: is_item_hidden(rid: RID, idx: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the item at index 'idx' is hidden.
See 'set_item_hidden' for more info on how to hide an item.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: is_item_radio_checkable(rid: RID, idx: int) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the item at index 'idx' has radio button-style checkability.
Note: This is purely cosmetic; you must add the logic for checking/unchecking items in radio groups.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: is_opened(rid: RID) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Returns true if the menu is currently opened.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: is_system_menu(rid: RID) -> bool const
metodos.desc:
Return true is global menu is a special system menu.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: popup(rid: RID, position: Vector2i) -> void
metodos.desc:
Shows the global menu at 'position' in the screen coordinates.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: remove_item(rid: RID, idx: int) -> void
metodos.desc:
Removes the item at index 'idx' from the global menu 'rid'.
Note: The indices of items after the removed item will be shifted by one.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_interface_direction(rid: RID, is_rtl: bool) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the menu text layout direction from right-to-left if 'is_rtl' is true.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_accelerator(rid: RID, idx: int, keycode: Key) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the accelerator of the item at index 'idx'. 'keycode' can be a single 'Key', or a combination of 'KeyModifierMask's and 'Key's using bitwise OR such as KEY_MASK_CTRL | KEY_A (Ctrl + A).
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_callback(rid: RID, idx: int, callback: Callable) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the callback of the item at index 'idx'. Callback is emitted when an item is pressed.
Note: The 'callback' Callable needs to accept exactly one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callable will be the value passed to the tag parameter when the menu item was created.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_checkable(rid: RID, idx: int, checkable: bool) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets whether the item at index 'idx' has a checkbox. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_checked(rid: RID, idx: int, checked: bool) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the checkstate status of the item at index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_disabled(rid: RID, idx: int, disabled: bool) -> void
metodos.desc:
Enables/disables the item at index 'idx'. When it is disabled, it can't be selected and its action can't be invoked.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_hidden(rid: RID, idx: int, hidden: bool) -> void
metodos.desc:
Hides/shows the item at index 'idx'. When it is hidden, an item does not appear in a menu and its action cannot be invoked.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_hover_callbacks(rid: RID, idx: int, callback: Callable) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the callback of the item at index 'idx'. The callback is emitted when an item is hovered.
Note: The 'callback' Callable needs to accept exactly one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callable will be the value passed to the tag parameter when the menu item was created.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_icon(rid: RID, idx: int, icon: Texture2D) -> void
metodos.desc:
Replaces the Texture2D icon of the specified 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.
Note: This method is not supported by macOS Dock menu items.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_indentation_level(rid: RID, idx: int, level: int) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the horizontal offset of the item at the given 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_index(rid: RID, idx: int, target_idx: int) -> int
metodos.desc:
Changes the index of the item at index 'idx' to be at index 'target_idx'. This can be used to move an item above other items.
Returns the new index of the moved item, it's not guaranteed to be the same as 'target_idx'.
Note: The indices of any items between index 'idx' and index 'target_idx' will be shifted by one.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_key_callback(rid: RID, idx: int, key_callback: Callable) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the callback of the item at index 'idx'. Callback is emitted when its accelerator is activated.
Note: The 'key_callback' Callable needs to accept exactly one Variant parameter, the parameter passed to the Callable will be the value passed to the tag parameter when the menu item was created.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_max_states(rid: RID, idx: int, max_states: int) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets number of state of a multistate item. See 'add_multistate_item' for details.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_radio_checkable(rid: RID, idx: int, checkable: bool) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the type of the item at the specified index 'idx' to radio button. If false, sets the type of the item to plain text.
Note: This is purely cosmetic; you must add the logic for checking/unchecking items in radio groups.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_state(rid: RID, idx: int, state: int) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the state of a multistate item. See 'add_multistate_item' for details.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_submenu(rid: RID, idx: int, submenu_rid: RID) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the submenu RID of the item at index 'idx'. The submenu is a global menu that would be shown when the item is clicked.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_tag(rid: RID, idx: int, tag: Variant) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the metadata of an item, which may be of any type. You can later get it with 'get_item_tag', which provides a simple way of assigning context data to items.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_text(rid: RID, idx: int, text: String) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the text of the item at index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_item_tooltip(rid: RID, idx: int, tooltip: String) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the String tooltip of the item at the specified index 'idx'.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_minimum_width(rid: RID, width: float) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the minimum width of the global menu.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_popup_close_callback(rid: RID, callback: Callable) -> void
metodos.desc:
Registers callable to emit when the menu is about to show.
Note: The OS can simulate menu opening to track menu item changes and global shortcuts, in which case the corresponding close callback is not triggered. Use 'is_opened' to check if the menu is currently opened.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS and Windows.

metodos.assinatura: set_popup_open_callback(rid: RID, callback: Callable) -> void
metodos.desc:
Registers callable to emit after the menu is closed.
Note: This method is implemented only on macOS.

metodos.assinatura: set_system_menu_text(menu_id: NativeMenu.SystemMenus, name: String) -> void
metodos.desc:
Sets the text of the system menu item.
Note: This method is implemented on macOS.

constantes.desc: NativeMenu supports native global main menu.
NativeMenu supports menu open and close callbacks.
NativeMenu supports menu item hover callback.

Application (first menu after "Apple" menu on macOS) menu ID.
